correctness.rationale: A complete output-indexed bijective encoding forces exactly r target bits of each parity in each final-coordinate slice, counted by (r!)^(2s). It forces exactly s sources of each parity for each first-coordinate value, counted by extracted polynomial coefficient and (s!)^(2r). All choices are uniquely invertible, proving no omission or overcount for all r,s. Opposite-semigroup inversion and r=1,2 expansions are exact. Eight direct brute-force permutation cases match.

value.rationale: Exact transversal numbers for the canonical Rees rectangular groups over C2, the smallest Hall–Paige obstruction, are the natural counting refinement of the known existence criterion. The closed coefficient formula enumerates arbitrary index sets without factorial-size permutation search; its nontrivial two-row binomial specialization produces explicit new positive counts for an infinite parameter family. This is a canonical algebraic invariant, not an unmotivated arbitrary slice.
